c74object.name: bachmcp.bpatcher.selector
c74object.digest: Selector and panel, for a bpatcher
c74object.description: The view of bachmcp.selector: load it in a bpatcher with the instance's name in @args. Scores come in and go out as lllls, so it connects directly to a bach.roll.

inlet.digest: A score as a llll (from bach.roll), and every message of bachmcp.algo.select

outlet.digest: Selected notes as a llll (connect to another bach.roll)
To bach.roll: dump, clearselection, sel note

objarg.name: name
objarg.description: The name the model and the server know this instance by. Unique across open patches.
